rationale: The hallway motion sensor (SEN-M1) was running firmware 1.1 speaking protocol v2, while the base station auto-updated to 4.5 and now only supports protocol v3, producing E-305 and "connected_no_events". The KB confirms SEN-M1 1.1 has an OTA path to 1.4, and after triggering the OTA the sensor upgraded and motion alerts resumed, confirming the firmware mismatch was the cause.

repair_steps: In the app, go to the Hallway Motion sensor settings and trigger a firmware update (OTA) for it.
Confirm the sensor upgrades from firmware 1.1 to 1.4.
Verify that motion events start appearing again in the app.
output.customer_reply: We identified that your hallway motion sensor needed a firmware update to work with the latest base station software. I've guided you through updating it, and it's now sending alerts again. If you notice any further issues, please don't hesitate to reach out. Thank you for your patience!

args.query: E-305 protocol v2 not supported OTA upgrade peripheral fails

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

results.source: historical_cases#H-03 Indoor camera lost after night update
results.text: After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

result.outcome: I found the update option in the Hallway Motion settings and ran it. It took about three minutes and finished, and now the motion alerts are coming through again.

complaint: Since yesterday my hallway motion sensor doesn't send any alerts. It still shows in the app. The LED blinks when I walk past it, so it seems to be working, and I changed its battery last month. We never touch the base station settings, but I think it installs things at night by itself. The front door sensor next to it is working fine.
